a.text: Being upfront: there's an 80% storm chance after every round, so the agreement needs 2+ storm-free rounds (about 4% odds) and would likely leave us both dead. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough to save one of us. I plan to take 4 in round 1 and I'm telling you now rather than defecting silently. If we both take, it's a random split and likely both die, so I'd suggest you operate or wait. If no storm hits, I'll give back or operate to help you reach 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round because the storm odds make the 2-round plan near-hopeless. I won't take any more. If we survive, I'll operate every round to refill the reserve for you, and you can take the next 4 cells.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
